name: New Bark Cave
description: An empty, fully lit cave at Route 29's east end, just west of New Bark Town. One open chamber with a south exit back to the route. Reach it after choosing your first starter; no Flash, badges, or HMs needed. No wild encounters, trainers, NPCs, items, or quests yet. Includes all six-starter and EXP-option features from v1.3.
notes: Empty cave test build. Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading. Existing map IDs, progress flags, and save layout are preserved; v1.3 save/reopen tested. Saves inside the cave require v1.4 or newer: leave and save outside before reverting to an older patch. Use CONTINUE, not numbered states from another ROM. Complete playthrough remains unverified.
